title: CAT 2021 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Quantitative Ability - Profit, Loss and Discount
subject: Quantitative Ability

questions.q: Amal purchases some pens at ₹ 8 each. To sell these, he hires an employee at a fixed wage. He sells 100 of these pens at ₹ 12 each. If the remaining pens are sold at ₹ 11 each, then he makes a net profit of ₹ 300, while he makes a net loss of ₹ 300 if the remaining pens are sold at ₹ 9 each. The wage of the employee, in INR, is
questions.explain:
Let the total number of pens be $100 + x$ and the employee's wage be $W$.
Cost Price of all pens = $8(100 + x) = 800 + 8x$.
Case 1 (remaining sold at ₹ 11): Revenue = $12(100) + 11x = 1200 + 11x$.
Profit = Revenue - (Cost Price + Wage) = $(1200 + 11x) - (800 + 8x + W) = 400 + 3x - W = 300$.
Thus, $3x - W = -100$.
Case 2 (remaining sold at ₹ 9): Revenue = $12(100) + 9x = 1200 + 9x$.
Loss = 300 $\implies$ Profit = -300.
$(1200 + 9x) - (800 + 8x + W) = 400 + x - W = -300$.
Thus, $x - W = -700$.
Subtracting the two equations:
$(3x - W) - (x - W) = -100 - (-700) \implies 2x = 600 \implies x = 300$.
Substitute $x = 300$ into the second equation:
$300 - W = -700 \implies W = 1000$.
